name: 28858-textonly-vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine, served in-process through guidellm's vllm_python backend.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, ~8.29B params (~16.6 GB): a 28-layer language model (hidden 3584, 28 query / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128) behind a 32-layer native-resolution ViT (patch 14, spatial merge 2).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 6000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, seed static 28858.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no media: one prefix bucket at weight 100 with prefix_count 1 and prefix_tokens 7000 -- a ~7000-token document that is byte-identical on every request and is sent as the system message -- plus a fresh 128-token question as the user message and exactly 16 output tokens (min=max, so the backend sets max_tokens=16 and ignore_eos). About 7200 tokens of context per request including the chat template's own tokens.
purpose: A document question-answering assistant on a 7B vision-language model, 64 concurrent users sharing one 7000-token policy document, brief answers, single GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Every key is a declared value; nothing here was searched for.
# The engine is a source checkout named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`, not a released wheel.
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
enable-prefix-caching: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
